fnol_text: My name is Amara Sorensen and I live at 175 Linden Drive, Greenville, SC 29659. You can reach me on (555) 354-3527 or amara.sorensen@example.com. After the torrential rain on the night of 15 August 2024, rainwater ran off the field behind us, across the back garden and in under the patio doors. About 5 cm of water covered the kitchen and family room floors. Policy HH-2023-00068. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mr Sorensen on (555) 354-3527 to acknowledge the claim. Amara confirmed the loss date as 15 August 2024.
Site visit to 175 Linden Drive. Neighbour Tomas McBride was present and confirmed the timeline.
Amara sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
